# Open311 municipal service operations

Connect a public service-request endpoint, retain its original responses, review changing cases, assign internal work, and deliver a complete customer workspace. The same application provides a local browser desk, an operating CLI, a typed source client, original-file export, and receiving into another workspace.

Use **Node 22.13 or newer**. The workspace uses built-in SQLite; the protocol client and domain functions use only Node built-ins.

## Open the desk

From the seller SDK directory:

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs serve --workspace /private/municipal-desk --port 0
~~~

The command prints one compact startup JSON line containing the local URL, workspace ID and launch binding. The Applications launcher can pass --expected-workspace-id and --expected-binding-sha256 to reopen that exact workspace. Keep one persistent workspace directory so the connection records, captures, reviews and operation history reopen together. The browser interface and CLI use that same workspace.

A connection has a stable ID, endpoint and optional jurisdiction. Its endpoint and jurisdiction remain bound to that ID after source capture. Add another connection ID for a different source.

## Connect an actual provider

Save this Helsinki connection as a local JSON file:

~~~json
{
  "id": "helsinki",
  "name": "Helsinki public service requests",
  "baseUrl": "https://palautteet.hel.fi/public-api/open311-public-service/v1",
  "responseLimit": 200,
  "pagination": false,
  "extendedAttributes": true,
  "statusValues": ["READY", "PROCESSING"],
  "queryExtensions": ["locale", "updated_after", "updated_before", "lat", "long", "radius"],
  "attribution": {
    "publisher": "Helsingin kaupunginkanslia",
    "title": "The Issue Reporting API of the City of Helsinki",
    "license": "CC BY 4.0",
    "licenseUrl": "https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/",
    "sourceUrl": "https://hri.fi/data/en_GB/dataset/helsingin-kaupungin-palauterajapinta"
  }
}
~~~

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs connection-put \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --file helsinki-connection.json --request-id helsinki-connect-01
~~~

Provider references:

- [City of Helsinki API description, October 2025](https://www.hel.fi/static/avoindata/kanslia/Open311_API_description_011025.pdf)
- [Helsinki Region Infoshare catalog and source license](https://hri.fi/data/en_GB/dataset/helsingin-kaupungin-palauterajapinta)
- [FixMyStreet provider documentation](https://www.fixmystreet.com/open311)

The Helsinki profile retains its native status names and declared 200-record response limit. Public results are the provider's published subset. Attribution travels with the connection and customer export. Provider settings remain editable as documentation changes, while the source connection identity remains stable.

For a credentialed endpoint, set apiKeyEnv to the environment-variable name on the operator host. The client resolves it when opening the connection and redacts its credential parameter in URL receipts. A direct apiKey is also available for private programmatic use. Additional settings include timeoutMs, maxResponseBytes, discoveryUrl, jurisdictionId, and allowHttp.

## Capture the catalog and requests

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs capture \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --connection helsinki --kind services --request-id helsinki-services-01

node open311/cli.mjs services \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk --connection helsinki
~~~

A declared provider parameter such as locale can be supplied in a JSON file with --query. For an entry declaring metadata, read its service definition with --kind service --resource-id SERVICE_CODE. The complete definition and arbitrary provider fields stay in the saved response.

Capture an explicit request window:

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs capture \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --connection helsinki --kind requests \
  --start 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z --end 2026-09-02T00:00:00Z \
  --extensions true --request-id helsinki-september-01

node open311/cli.mjs capture-info \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk --id CAPTURE_ID
~~~

Use the actual capture ID returned by the first command. Complete captures include original response bytes, byte length and SHA-256, parsed values, normalized rows, selected query, source connection, HTTP status and observation time. Base64 retains the original body in portable JSON. capture.query records the parameters actually sent; requestedQuery preserves the original operator selection when the protocol overrides filters.

The GeoReport v2 core uses timezone-qualified date filters, a maximum 90-day interval, and a default cap of 1,000 requests. ID selection overrides other filters. JSON availability is provider-specific; paging and extended attributes are separate extensions. References: [core](https://wiki.open311.org/GeoReport_v2/), [discovery](https://wiki.open311.org/Service_Discovery/), [extensions](https://wiki.open311.org/GeoReport_v2/Extensions/).

queryExtensions explicitly names additional provider parameters. A JSON query file carries those fields; inline CLI filters override matching file fields. Identifiers preserve case, including providers where differently capitalized category codes identify different services.

Each capture makes one selected endpoint request. A provider declaring pagination accepts --page and --page-size. Coverage metadata shows the declared limit and whether the returned count reaches it. Select a narrower source window or another supported page when needed, retaining each response as a separate capture.

## Review cases and source changes

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs requests \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --capture CAPTURE_ID --status PROCESSING --q street --offset 0 --limit 100

node open311/cli.mjs request \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --capture CAPTURE_ID --id SERVICE_REQUEST_ID

node open311/cli.mjs diff \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --before EARLIER_CAPTURE_ID --after LATER_CAPTURE_ID
~~~

Rows expose the source service, status, description, agency, address, dates and coordinates. Each retains the entire provider object and a deterministic source hash. Null fields, attachments, nested agencies and additional attributes remain in that object. Source status keeps the provider's own value.

Identity combines the saved jurisdiction connection with the exact request ID. Local service-code filters are case-sensitive. Malformed or duplicate identities surface as normalization errors while the original response remains available.

To capture a current individual case, use --kind request --resource-id SERVICE_REQUEST_ID. To resolve a provider token, use --kind token --resource-id TOKEN.

Comparisons identify additions, changes to original provider fields and unchanged records. Absence is reported only for matching explicit IDs or fixed source windows. Rolling windows do not establish comparable absence. The missingFromCapture field means that a record was absent from the later response; completion requires an actual provider status change.

## Assign internal work

Save a local review file:

~~~json
{
  "status": "assigned",
  "assignee": "Operations",
  "note": "Review source photos and route maintenance follow-through.",
  "dueDate": "2026-10-16"
}
~~~

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs review-put \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --connection helsinki --id SERVICE_REQUEST_ID \
  --file review.json --request-id case-review-01
~~~

Local status is new, assigned, in_progress or done. Reviews retain their source capture/hash association and history. Their operating status remains separate from the civic provider's original status.

The browser and CLI mutations carry requestId and expectedRevision. The CLI prints both before submitting. Preserve the same values and inputs to resume an operation:

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs operation \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk --id case-review-01
~~~

For an exact retry, pass --request-id case-review-01 --expected-revision ORIGINAL_REVISION to the original command. An overlapping edit returns a revision conflict. Review intervening work before submitting a new intended update with a new operation ID. An admitted capture keeps its source selection while concurrent local reviews retain their own changes.

## Deliver and reopen

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs export \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --kind workspace --out municipal-workspace.json

node open311/cli.mjs receive \
  --workspace /private/municipal-received \
  --file municipal-workspace.json --request-id municipal-receive-01
~~~

The receiving operation preserves source captures and review context. Open the receiving directory with serve or inspect it with state.

| Export kind | Complete output |
| --- | --- |
| source | Original response bytes |
| json | Capture, normalized rows and local reviews |
| csv | Tabular case handoff |
| report | Printable HTML operating report |
| workspace | Complete portable workspace |

For a selected capture:

~~~sh
node open311/cli.mjs export \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --kind source --capture CAPTURE_ID --out original-response.json

node open311/cli.mjs export \
  --workspace /private/municipal-desk \
  --kind report --capture CAPTURE_ID --out municipal-report.html
~~~

CLI output files use new paths and contain the complete result. Omit --out to write the full body to standard output. capture-info exposes the saved value, rows, raw body and receipt beyond state's summary.

## Programmatic client

index.mjs exports the lightweight client and pure domain functions, with matching index.d.mts declarations.

~~~js
import { createClient, normalizeRequests, queryRequests } from './open311/index.mjs';

const client = createClient(connection);
const source = await client.requests({
  start_date: '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z',
  end_date: '2026-09-02T00:00:00Z',
  extensions: true,
});
const rows = normalizeRequests(source.value, { connectionId: connection.id });
const page = queryRequests(rows, { status: 'PROCESSING', limit: 100 });
~~~

Methods are services, service, requests, request, token and discovery. Discovery uses a separately supplied discoveryUrl. Request options accept a cancellation signal. HTTP errors, invalid JSON, interrupted bodies and response-size failures carry Open311Error.result with the retained response and receipt. Partial bodies are marked complete: false. Redirect responses produce an HTTP error so an endpoint move can be selected explicitly.

The durable workspace module serves the CLI and local operator server. [Merchant setup, tools and typed SDK](MCP.md) expose that same workspace through the maintained merchant contract. [The browser operating guide](workspace/WORKSPACE.md) follows the complete customer desk. Source definitions are in index.d.mts; workspace.d.mts, server.d.mts and mcp-client.d.mts describe the original operating interfaces.

name: tjlabs-open311-windmill
x-logging: &native-logging
  driver: json-file
  options:
    max-size: "20m"
    max-file: "3"
    compress: "true"
services:
  db:
    image: ${POSTGRES_IMAGE:?Run commission.py prepare first}
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *native-logging
    shm_size: 1g
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?}
      POSTGRES_DB: windmill
    volumes:
      - postgres:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d windmill"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

  server:
    image: ${WINDMILL_IMAGE:?Run commission.py prepare first}
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *native-logging
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?}@db/windmill?sslmode=disable
      MODE: server
      BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:${WINDMILL_PORT:-8079}
      SUPERADMIN_SECRET: ${WINDMILL_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET:?}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${WINDMILL_PORT:-8079}:8000"
    volumes:
      - worker-logs:/tmp/windmill/logs
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy

  open311:
    image: ${NODE_IMAGE:?Run commission.py prepare first}
    init: true
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *native-logging
    working_dir: /source/integrations/windmill/open311
    command: ["node", "start-workspaces.mjs"]
    environment:
      OPEN311_DATA: /data
      OPEN311_SOURCE_MODE: ${OPEN311_SOURCE_MODE:-retained}
    volumes:
      - ${SOURCE_ROOT:?}:/source:ro
      - open311:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "Promise.all([7311,7312].map(p=>fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+p+'/health').then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.status)}))).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

  worker:
    image: ${WINDMILL_IMAGE:?}
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *native-logging
    network_mode: service:open311
    privileged: true
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?}@db/windmill?sslmode=disable
      BASE_INTERNAL_URL: http://server:8000
      MODE: worker
      WORKER_GROUP: default
      FAVOR_UNSHARE_PID: "true"
    volumes:
      - worker-cache:/tmp/windmill/cache
      - worker-logs:/tmp/windmill/logs
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      open311:
        condition: service_healthy
      server:
        condition: service_started

volumes:
  postgres:
  open311:
  worker-cache:
  worker-logs:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Commission the real Windmill jobs, native approval, exports and receiving workspace."""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import time
import urllib.parse
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from commission import HERE, FOLDER, SCRIPT, APP, Api, api_for, app_source, app_matches, built_app, read_json, write_json, now, up, stop

def check(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)
def sha(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
class Journey:
    def __init__(self, args):
        self.private,self.config,self.api=api_for(args)
        self.root=self.private/"journey"
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True,mode=0o700)
        self.prefix="/api/w/"+self.config["workspace"]
        self.timeout=args.timeout
        self.approve=args.approve_review
        self.jobs={}
        self.started=now()
    def job(self, job_id, missing=False):
        return self.api.call("GET",self.prefix+"/jobs_u/get/"+job_id,missing=missing)
    def submit(self, name, kind, path, arguments, launch=None):
        receipt=self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-submission.json")
        saved=read_json(receipt) if receipt.exists() else None
        job_id=saved["jobId"] if saved else str(uuid.uuid4())
        desired={**arguments,"runKey":"app-"+job_id.lower()} if launch else arguments
        if saved:
            request=saved
            check(request["path"]==path and request["kind"]==kind and request["arguments"]==desired
                  and request.get("launch")==launch,"Continue the saved "+name+" submission with its original inputs.")
        else:
            request={"name":name,"kind":kind,"path":path,"arguments":desired,"jobId":job_id,"launch":launch,"preparedAt":now()}
            write_json(receipt,request)
        existing=self.job(job_id,missing=True)
        if existing is None:
            try:
                if launch:
                    launched=self.call(name+"-launch","launch",arguments={"kind":launch,"jobId":job_id,"input":desired})
                    check(launched["jobId"]==job_id and launched["path"]==path,"The saved launcher returned another flow identity.")
                else:
                    endpoint=self.prefix+("/jobs/run/f/"if kind=="flow"else"/jobs/run/p/")+path+"?job_id="+job_id
                    returned=self.api.call("POST",endpoint,desired)
                    check(returned==job_id,"Windmill assigned another job identity.")
            except Exception:
                if self.job(job_id,missing=True) is None:
                    raise
            existing=self.job(job_id)
        check(existing["id"]==job_id and existing.get("script_path")==path and existing.get("args")==desired,
              "The native job identity belongs to another path or input: "+job_id)
        self.jobs[name]=job_id
        return job_id
    def restart_at_approval(self, name, flow_job, approval_job):
        completed = self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-services-restarted.json")
        pending = self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-services-restart.json")
        if completed.exists():
            saved = read_json(completed)
            check(saved["flowJobId"] == flow_job["id"] and saved["approvalJobId"] == approval_job["id"],
                  "Continue the original service restart and approval identity.")
            return saved
        if pending.exists():
            saved = read_json(pending)
            check(saved["flowJobId"] == flow_job["id"] and saved["approvalJobId"] == approval_job["id"],
                  "The retained restart belongs to another approval.")
        else:
            saved = {"schema":"tjlabs.windmill.open311.native-restart.v1","phase":"PREPARED","preparedAt":now(),
                     "project":self.config["project"],"flowJobId":flow_job["id"],"approvalJobId":approval_job["id"],
                     "flowBefore":flow_job,"approvalBefore":approval_job,"images":self.config["images"]}
            write_json(pending, saved)
        args = argparse.Namespace(private=self.private)
        if saved["phase"] == "PREPARED":
            # Stop and start this original Compose project without removing containers or volumes.
            stop(args)
            saved = {**saved,"phase":"STOPPED","stoppedAt":now()}
            write_json(pending, saved)
        up(args)
        resumed = self.job(flow_job["id"])
        retained_approval = self.job(approval_job["id"])
        check(resumed["id"] == saved["flowBefore"]["id"]
              and resumed.get("script_path") == saved["flowBefore"].get("script_path")
              and resumed.get("args") == saved["flowBefore"].get("args"),
              "The native review job changed across the service restart.")
        check(retained_approval["id"] == saved["approvalBefore"]["id"]
              and retained_approval.get("type") == "CompletedJob" and retained_approval.get("success") is True,
              "The original completed approval step was lost across the service restart.")
        saved = {**saved,"phase":"RESUMED","resumedAt":now(),"flowAfter":resumed,"approvalAfter":retained_approval}
        write_json(completed, saved)
        print(json.dumps({"phase":"NATIVE_SERVICES_RESTARTED","jobId":flow_job["id"],
                          "approvalJobId":approval_job["id"],"project":self.config["project"]}),flush=True)
        return saved
    def wait(self,name,job_id,approval=False):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+self.timeout
        decision=self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-approval-submitted.json")
        while True:
            job=self.job(job_id)
            if job["type"]=="CompletedJob":
                write_json(self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-job.json"),job)
                result=self.api.call("GET",self.prefix+"/jobs_u/completed/get_result/"+job_id)
                write_json(self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-result.json"),result)
                check(job.get("success") is True,"Native Windmill job failed: "+name+" / "+job_id+". Inspect its saved result and logs.")
                return result
            if approval:
                modules=job.get("flow_status",{}).get("modules",[])
                step=next((m for m in modules if m.get("id")=="approval"),None)
                suspended=next((m for m in modules if m.get("type")=="WaitingForEvents"
                                and step and m.get("job")==step.get("job")),None)
                if step and step.get("job") and suspended:
                    child=self.job(step["job"])
                    if child.get("type")=="CompletedJob" and child.get("success"):
                        value=self.api.call("GET",self.prefix+"/jobs_u/completed/get_result/"+step["job"])
                        if value.get("resume") and not decision.exists():
                            write_json(self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-approval-job.json"),child)
                            write_json(self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-approval-request.json"),value)
                            self.restart_at_approval(name,job,child)
                            if self.approve:
                                # This submits a real event to the URL issued by Windmill for this precise suspended job.
                                response=self.api.resume(value["resume"],{})
                                write_json(decision,{"submittedAt":now(),"flowJobId":job_id,"approvalJobId":step["job"],"method":"native approval endpoint","response":response})
                                print(json.dumps({"phase":"APPROVAL_SUBMITTED","jobId":job_id}),flush=True)
                            else:
                                print(json.dumps({"phase":"AWAITING_OPERATOR_APPROVAL","jobId":job_id,
                                    "run":self.config["base"]+"/run/"+job_id+"?workspace="+self.config["workspace"]}),flush=True)
                                approval=False
            if time.monotonic()>=deadline:
                write_json(self.root/"jobs"/(name+"-current-job.json"),job)
                raise RuntimeError("The saved native job remains available: "+job_id+". Continue this same journey to collect it.")
            time.sleep(1)
    def call(self,name,action,target="source",arguments=None):
        args={"action":action,"target":target,"args":arguments or {}}
        return self.wait(name,self.submit(name,"script",SCRIPT,args))
    def flow(self,name,flow,args,approval=False,launch=False):
        return self.wait(name,self.submit(name,"flow","f/"+FOLDER+"/"+flow,args,launch=flow if launch else None),approval=approval)
    def files(self,delivery,directory):
        destination=self.root/directory
        destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        for file in delivery["files"]:
            content=base64.b64decode(file["body"],validate=True)
            check(len(content)==file["bytes"] and sha(content)==file["sha256"],"The native download changed: "+file["filename"])
            check(pathlib.PurePath(file["filename"]).name==file["filename"],"Use an export filename without directory traversal.")
            (destination/file["filename"]).write_bytes(content)
    def run(self):
        check((self.private/"deployment.json").exists(),"Deploy the complete scripts, flows and built app first.")
        deployment=read_json(self.private/"deployment.json")
        value,policy=app_source()
        installed=self.api.call("GET",self.prefix+"/apps/get/p/"+APP)
        check(app_matches(installed,value,policy),"Deploy the current complete app source and backend bindings before commissioning.")
        compiled=built_app(self.private,self.api,self.prefix,installed)
        prior=deployment.get("builtApp")
        if prior:
            check(compiled["version"]==prior["version"] and compiled["sourceSha256"]==prior["sourceSha256"]
                  and compiled["files"]==prior["files"],"The served app bundle differs from the deployed version.")
        write_json(self.root/"built-app.json",compiled)
        initial=self.call("initial","overview")
        receiver_initial=self.call("receiver-initial","overview","receiver")
        check(not initial["captures"] and not initial["reviews"],"Use a fresh source installation for this complete commissioning journey.")
        check(not receiver_initial["captures"] and not receiver_initial["connections"],"Use a fresh receiving destination.")
        capture_args={"runKey":"windmill-native-initial","connectionId":"helsinki-public","servicesQuery":{"locale":"en"},
                      "requestsQuery":{"start_date":"2026-10-08T08:00:00Z","end_date":"2026-10-08T12:00:00Z","extensions":True}}
        capture=self.flow("capture","refresh",capture_args,launch=True)
        capture_ticket=read_json(self.root/"jobs/capture-submission.json")
        launch_replay=self.call("capture-launch-replay","launch",arguments={"kind":"refresh","jobId":capture_ticket["jobId"],
                                                                          "input":capture_ticket["arguments"]})
        check(launch_replay["jobId"]==capture_ticket["jobId"] and launch_replay["path"]==capture_ticket["path"]
              and launch_replay["replayed"] is True,"Reopening the saved launch created another native flow.")
        capture_id=capture["requests"]["capture"]["id"]
        source=self.call("original-requests","capture",arguments={"captureId":capture_id})
        services=self.call("services","services",arguments={"connectionId":"helsinki-public"})
        check(len(source["items"])==3 and len(services["items"])==5,"The original Helsinki catalogue/request inventory differs.")
        check(sorted(row["serviceRequestId"]for row in source["items"])==["3553245","3553339","3553509"],"The original request identities changed.")
        retained=read_json(HERE/"fixtures"/"helsinki-retained-source.json")
        check(any(c["raw"]["sha256"]==source["raw"]["sha256"] and c["raw"]["bytes"]==source["raw"]["bytes"]for c in retained["captures"]),"The captured source differs from its original retained body.")
        review_args={"runKey":"windmill-native-review","captureId":capture_id,
            "selection":[{"serviceRequestId":row["serviceRequestId"],"sourceSha256":row["sourceSha256"],"priorReviewId":(row.get("review")or{}).get("requestId")}for row in source["items"]],
            "review":{"status":"assigned","assignee":"Operations desk","dueDate":"2026-10-16",
                      "note":"Review the original Helsinki feedback and prepare the operator handover."}}
        reviewed=self.flow("review","review_delivery",review_args,approval=True)
        check(len(reviewed["reviews"]["results"])==3,"The approval did not apply all three selected assignments.")
        self.files(reviewed["delivery"],"approved-delivery")
        again_args={**capture_args,"runKey":"windmill-native-repeat"}
        repeated=self.flow("capture-repeat","refresh",again_args)
        second_id=repeated["requests"]["capture"]["id"]
        comparison=self.call("comparison","diff",arguments={"before":capture_id,"after":second_id})
        check(len(comparison["unchanged"])==3 and not comparison["added"] and not comparison["changed"] and not comparison["missingFromCapture"],"Repeated original captures changed request content.")
        before_replay=self.call("before-replay","overview")
        replay=self.flow("capture-replay","refresh",again_args)
        check(replay["requests"]["capture"]["id"]==second_id and replay["services"]["capture"]["id"]==repeated["services"]["capture"]["id"],"Repeating the flow created duplicate source captures.")
        source_final=self.call("source-final","overview")
        check(source_final["revision"]==before_replay["revision"],"The source changed while replaying the same native flow.")
        delivery=self.call("final-delivery","export_pack",arguments={"captureId":second_id})
        self.files(delivery,"downloads")
        received=self.flow("receive","transfer",{"runKey":"windmill-native-receive","source":True,"bundle":None})
        reopened=received["reopen"]
        check(reopened["workspaceId"]==source_final["workspaceId"],"Receiving changed the original workspace identity.")
        check(reopened["captures"]==source_final["captures"] and reopened["reviews"]==source_final["reviews"],"Receiving changed captures or reviews.")
        check(reopened["requests"]["items"]==source_final["requests"]["items"],"Receiving changed original request rows.")
        receiving_delivery=self.call("received-delivery","export_pack","receiver",{"captureId":second_id})
        self.files(receiving_delivery,"received-downloads")
        original_files={file["filename"]:file for file in delivery["files"]}
        for file in receiving_delivery["files"]:
            if file["filename"].startswith("open311-workspace-"):
                continue
            original=original_files.get(file["filename"])
            check(original and original["sha256"]==file["sha256"] and original["bytes"]==file["bytes"],"Receiving changed "+file["filename"])
        source_bundle=json.loads(base64.b64decode(next(f["body"]for f in delivery["files"]if f["filename"].startswith("open311-workspace-"))))
        receiving_bundle=json.loads(base64.b64decode(next(f["body"]for f in receiving_delivery["files"]if f["filename"].startswith("open311-workspace-"))))
        received_ops={o["requestId"]:o for o in receiving_bundle["payload"]["operations"]}
        for operation in source_bundle["payload"]["operations"]:
            check(received_ops.get(operation["requestId"])==operation,"An original workspace operation changed during receiving.")
        summary={"schema":"tjlabs.windmill.open311.native-journey.v1","status":"PASSED","startedAt":self.started,"completedAt":now(),
                 "base":self.config["base"],"workspace":self.config["workspace"],"sourceWorkspaceId":source_final["workspaceId"],
                 "sourceRevision":source_final["revision"],"receivedRevision":reopened["revision"],
                 "services":len(services["items"]),"requests":len(source["items"]),"reviews":len(reopened["reviews"]),
                 "captures":len(reopened["captures"]),"unchangedRequests":len(comparison["unchanged"]),
                 "approval":{"flowJobId":self.jobs["review"],"decisionSaved":(self.root/"jobs/review-approval-submitted.json").exists()},
                 "restart":read_json(self.root/"jobs/review-services-restarted.json"),
                 "launch":{"flowJobId":self.jobs["capture"],"launcherJobId":self.jobs.get("capture-launch"),
                           "replayJobId":self.jobs["capture-launch-replay"],"replayed":launch_replay["replayed"]},
                 "deployedSources":{"sourceCommit":deployment.get("sourceCommit"),"scriptHash":deployment["script"]["hash"],
                                    "flowVersions":{name:flow.get("version_id")for name,flow in deployment["flows"].items()}},
                 "builtApp":compiled,"jobs":self.jobs,"downloads":[{k:v for k,v in f.items()if k!="body"}for f in delivery["files"]]}
        write_json(self.root/"result.json",summary)
        print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
        return summary
def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--private",type=pathlib.Path,default=HERE/".private")
    parser.add_argument("--approve-review",action="store_true",help="Submit the commissioning review through its actual native Windmill approval URL.")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout",type=int,default=900,help="Seconds to wait per existing native job before saving its current state.")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    # A prior invocation may have stopped the services before its process ended.
    pending=args.private.resolve()/"journey/jobs/review-services-restart.json"
    completed=args.private.resolve()/"journey/jobs/review-services-restarted.json"
    if pending.exists() and not completed.exists():
        up(args)
    journey=Journey(args)
    try:
        journey.run()
    except Exception as error:
        write_json(journey.root/"failure.json",{"status":"FAILED","at":now(),"error":str(error),"jobs":journey.jobs})
        raise
if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

# Open311 service operations for Windmill

A complete operator workspace for public service requests: capture original data, assign work through a native approval, compare saved source editions, and deliver a portable workspace another operator can reopen.

The project installs one maintained Bun script, three Windmill flows and a full-code React app. It uses the existing Open311 SQLite workspace in this repository. The source service and independent receiving service run as their original Node servers. Windmill's worker shares their private network namespace; the Open311 API keeps its loopback binding.

## Operator workflow

1. Open **Service operations** in Windmill and choose **Source workspace**.
2. Select **Capture source**. The flow saves the service catalogue and the fixed-window request response, with their original bytes and receipt.
3. Select requests, enter an internal status, assignee, due date and note, then select **Review selected**. Open the native Windmill run, inspect the proposed assignment and approve or reject it.
4. Open **Transfer** to download the delivery files. The pack contains original source, normalized JSON, CSV and HTML for requests and services, plus the complete workspace export.
5. Capture the same source window again and use **Comparison** to inspect added, changed, unchanged and missing rows. The original workspace decides whether the query scopes support a missing-row comparison.
6. Receive the complete workspace into the independent destination and open **Received workspace**. Captures, reviews, history and original operations remain available under the original workspace identity.

**Activity** keeps native job links and interrupted submissions. Before dispatch, the app saves the complete input and a new job UUID in this browser's IndexedDB. Its launch action reopens that exact job or submits the declared flow with that UUID, checking the saved flow path and input. A browser refresh restores pending actions; select **Resume submission** to continue the original action. Once Windmill confirms the job, the app removes the local input and retains the job link. The app retains every active job and the 30 most recent completed jobs. A partially completed assignment batch retains one original operation per request.

All flow and metadata files use JSON syntax, which is valid YAML. The installer reads them with Python's standard library. The same workspace tree is suitable for Windmill's CLI.

## Install on an existing Docker host

Use a checkout of this repository, Python 3 and Docker Compose v2. The worker follows Windmill's published privileged-worker configuration. This project uses its own Compose project and named volumes.

From this directory:

    python3 commission.py prepare
    python3 commission.py up
    python3 commission.py deploy

The first command pulls the official images and records their actual immutable repository digests in the private installation. The server and worker use the same pinned Windmill image. PostgreSQL 18 stores its data under /var/lib/postgresql, matching the current upstream layout.

The default native app address is:

    http://127.0.0.1:8079/apps/get/f/tjlabs_open311/operations?workspace=open311_operations

The generated local operator email and password are in .private/installation.json. Use them on the local Windmill login page. The installer creates this local account without sending email. Keep the private directory with the installation; it also contains image identities, deployment readbacks and job continuity records.

For another loopback port, pass the same --port value to the initial prepare command. Use --private /absolute/private/directory when keeping installation state outside the checkout.

Only the Windmill UI port is published, on loopback. The source API uses 7311 and the receiver uses 7312 inside the shared namespace. A public deployment needs the host's normal authenticated routing and deployment configuration.

To stop or resume the same installation:

    python3 commission.py stop
    python3 commission.py up

Named volumes retain PostgreSQL, the source workspace, the receiving workspace, worker cache and native worker logs.

## Complete native commissioning

Run the full workflow on a fresh installation:

    python3 native-journey.py --approve-review
    python3 commission.py logs

The journey creates real Windmill jobs for source capture, reads, review, comparison, delivery and transfer. Its approval call submits an event to the exact URL returned by the native approval step. Omit --approve-review to approve from the native run page while the journey waits.

The journey selects the three retained requests, assigns all three, downloads the complete delivery, repeats the same source window, replays a flow under the same source operation identities, and receives the workspace independently. It compares every original request/service export and every original workspace operation after receive.

A prepared native job UUID is saved before submission. If a client connection is interrupted, rerun the same command with the same private directory: it inspects that job and collects or continues the existing operation. Original inputs are kept in .private/journey/jobs. Complete downloads and result files are in .private/journey.

For a walkthrough, use the built app after commissioning. Show the queue and assignment history, open the actual approval run, compare the two saved captures, download a report, and switch to the received workspace. Follow WALKTHROUGH.md for a short recording that covers the complete operator journey.

## Original source and data

The included public Helsinki responses were observed on 8 October 2026. They contain five services and three requests for the exact request window 08:00–12:00 UTC. The manifest retains the original URLs, source observation times, bytes, hashes and actual import provenance. The original origin HTTP status and headers remain null where the source import did not supply them.

The default service mode replays those original responses through the repository's original Open311 client. It requires an exact request-URL match. The capture receipt retains the original observation and records the replay time separately.

To use the actual network client, prepare a separate installation with --source-mode live and supply the appropriate query inputs when running the capture flow. The included app presents the retained Helsinki window. Service credentials, where needed for another connection, belong in the host environment referenced by the connection's apiKeyEnv.

Publisher: City of Helsinki — Helsingin kaupunginkanslia. Dataset: [The Issue Reporting API of the City of Helsinki](https://hri.fi/data/en_GB/dataset/helsingin-kaupungin-palauterajapinta). License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

## Integration contracts

Prepared capture inputs include the original request ID, workspace UUID, observed revision and payload hash. Windmill keeps preparation and application in separate steps, so a retained apply step can resume the exact input. The original service handles operation replay and revision conflicts.

Review plans retain selected source hashes and prior review identities before approval. Application checks current source and review identities before each mutation. Completed rows replay their original operation result if a batch resumes.

The app's backends fix their action in Windmill's execution policy. Read bindings expose the selected original read operation. The launch binding permits only the declared capture, review and transfer paths. It fixes the flow run key to the saved job UUID and verifies any existing job's path and full input before continuing. Worker credentials come from Windmill's native job environment. The native approval uses the community approval mechanism; the assignment form is part of this React app.

Receiving uses the original complete-workspace format and validation. It requires an empty destination. After receiving, the destination exposes the original workspace UUID; refresh or reopen the receiving view before the next operation.
